comment: Version-1 / legacy spellings a dual-read consumer must still accept (docs/audits/for-serde-vocab-1.md §Migration). Every value here normalizes to the canonical tag in fsv1_canonical.json. The bare "unknown" TLS version is lossy — the raw wire value is irrecoverable and maps to LEGACY_UNKNOWN_WIRE (0xFFFF), never to a fabricated version.
